title: Foot posture as a risk factor for lower limb overuse injury: a systematic review and meta-analysis
publisher: Journal of Foot and Ankle Research
claims: 系统综述纳入 21 项研究、6,228 人。

There is strong evidence that a pronated foot posture is a risk factor for medial tibial stress syndrome (MTSS), with a small pooled effect size of 0.28; the same review reported 0.33 for patellofemoral pain.
Static measures of foot posture should be used as part of a multifactorial injury risk assessment and not considered in isolation.
